newsitem.title: FRANCE: French airline strike off, signs of breakthrough.
newsitem.headline: French airline strike off, signs of breakthrough.

text.p: French airline pilots' unions have called off a strike slated for December 10-11, amid signs of a possible breakthrough in a long-running labour conflict, a spokesman for the SNPL pilots' union said on Thursday.

The transport ministry agreed to set up a working group with the job of drafting a national accord on job contracts and work conditions and to look into sub-contracting by airlines, another major point of contention with the unions, the spokesman said.
Pilots have staged a string of one- and two-day strikes over the past few months with the latest 48-hour stoppage last week.
The SNPL spokesman said the protests were now being put on hold because of an agreement with the transport ministry which "augurs better for our future".

The first meetings of working groups on subcontracting will take place on December 11, to be followed on December 16 by the first meeting of the group in charge of drafting the nationwide framework agreement, the SNPL union said.
